 Siddiqui, for the Applicant.
Ms. A.S. Gotad, App for State.

Mr. Mahendra Dama Shinde, Police Head Constable, Roha Po
 Station, present.

1. Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned APP for Respondent/State.
2.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No.136 of 2023 registered with Roha Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 328 r/w. 34 of Indian Penal Code,
1860 ('IPC' for short) and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e) and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. According to the allegations in the FIR, co-accused - Dilip Palange, was found in possession of contraband articles being Gutakha Pan Masala and the present Applicant has been named by Nisar Hasan Chougule vs State Of Maharashtra on 28 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127970361/
1 co-accused persons.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Admittedly, the Applicant is protected by order dated 07.10.2023 for last about 2 years.

Learned APP on instructions of Head Constable of the concerned Police Station (who is present in the Court) submits that the Applicant has so far co-operated with the investigation and the charge-sheet is already filed and case is registered as R.C. No.15 of 2025, J.M.F.C. Roha, Raigad.

5. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, nature of allegations and the fact that the Applicant was protected by order of this Court and further considering that the issue of applicability of Section 328 of IPC to Gutakha is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, case for grant of pre-arrest bail is made.
6. The Application is allowed in terms of the order dated 07.10.2023.
The Applicant is directed to attend the trial regularly unless exempted by the concerned Court.
7. Application is disposed of in above terms.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
